# Legacy Bugbot pricing

This page documents Bugbot pricing before the [May 2026 pricing update](https://cursor.com/blog/may-2026-bugbot-changes). For current pricing, see [Bugbot pricing](https://cursor.com/docs/bugbot#pricing).

## [Legacy included reviews](https://cursor.com/docs/bugbot/legacy-pricing\#legacy-included-reviews)

On Teams and Individual Cursor plans, every user received a limited number of included PR reviews each month. For teams, each team member received their own included reviews. When you reached the limit, reviews paused until your next billing cycle.

## [Legacy paid pricing](https://cursor.com/docs/bugbot/legacy-pricing\#legacy-paid-pricing)

IndividualsTeams

### [Per-user billing](https://cursor.com/docs/bugbot/legacy-pricing\#per-user-billing)

Teams paid $40 per user per month for reviews.

We count a user as someone who authored PRs reviewed by Bugbot in a month.

All licenses were relinquished at the start of each billing cycle and assigned on a first-come, first-served basis. If a user didn't author any PRs reviewed by Bugbot in a month, the seat could be used by another user.

### [Seat limits](https://cursor.com/docs/bugbot/legacy-pricing\#seat-limits)

Team admins could set maximum Bugbot seats per month to control costs.

### [Abuse guardrails](https://cursor.com/docs/bugbot/legacy-pricing\#abuse-guardrails)

In order to prevent abuse, we have a pooled cap of 200 pull requests per month for every Bugbot license. If you need more than 200 pull requests per month, reach out through the [help center](https://cursor.com/help/ai-features/bugbot) and we'll increase it.

For example, if your team has 100 users, your organization will initially be able to review 20,000 pull requests per month. If you reach that limit naturally, please reach out to us and we'll be happy to increase the limit.
